verdict.rationale: Kit publishes a documented V4 public API. The docs cover two auth mechanisms (API keys for your own account, plus OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, refresh and revocation flows), cursor pagination, bulk and async processing, full broadcast CRUD with stats, custom fields, account endpoints, and signed webhooks with retries. A remote MCP server exposes account read/write to AI clients, and an llms.txt is live. missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found (all probed candidate paths returned 404), no independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented.
